            e_curr = cell('W0::Effective rates', f'E{rr}')
            e_start = cell('W0::Effective rates', f'F{rr}')
            if e_curr == curr and e_start <= edate < e_end:
                rate = e_rate
                break
        if rate is not None:
            total += amt * rate
result = round(total, 2)
